title: Water consumed per megawatt-hour by generating technology and cooling, medians from Macknick and colleagues, 2012
description: Bar chart of median operational water consumption, in gallons per megawatt-hour, from the literature review by Macknick, Newmark, Heath and Hallett (2012): wind 0, utility-scale photovoltaics 1, gas combined cycle with dry cooling 2, gas combined cycle once-through 100, gas combined cycle with a cooling tower 205, coal once-through 250, nuclear once-through 269, nuclear with a cooling tower 672 and coal with a cooling tower 687. Hydropower's median, 4,491, is left off the chart, as the paper's own figures leave it off. Data: Environmental Research Letters 7, 045802, tables 1 and 2.
heading: WATER CONSUMED · GALLONS PER MWH · MEDIANS
